note: Meaning-preservation corpus for dictation smart cleanup. Every fixture states what must survive verbatim, what the cleanup must drop, and what it must never invent. must_keep entries are matched case-insensitively against the cleaned text; must_drop and never entries must be absent. min_retention/max_addition bound how much content a fixture may legitimately lose or normalize; fixtures that delete nothing keep the strict default.
